zh-CN.title: 重要通知更可信
items: 运营任免与投稿审批通知现在带有不可伪造的官方通知标识
重要通知会进入会话未读和提醒，不再容易错过

en.title: More trustworthy important notices
items: Operator role and submission review updates now carry a server-verified official notice badge
Important notices now appear in chat unread counts and notifications so they are harder to miss
